apps_subtitle: We build software that solves real problems in Africa — with a focus on accessibility, privacy and technological independence.
app_onara_desc: Offline study assistant for African students. Runs AI models locally on your phone, no internet, no costs and no tracking.

services_subtitle: Beyond our free apps, HamirStudios provides digital services to companies, institutions and individuals. Launch prices — first 5 clients.

service_chat_ia_desc: Intelligent and personalized customer service. Requires dedicated backend.

service_note: Kwanza values calculated at official BNA exchange rate (1 € ≈ 1,100 Kz). Final value confirmed on quote date.

launch_3: In return, we only ask permission to use the project in our portfolio and a small testimonial.
about_p1: I build technology that works where the internet doesn't reach. I believe software should solve real problems and serve people, regardless of their context.
about_p2: I'm the creator of Onara.AI, JurisAO and Muxima Player — 100% offline, private and free applications. Rooted in Luanda, HamirStudios was born from the desire to prove that world-class technology can be built in Angola.
about_p3: Beyond code: I'm a bassist and founder of Ovelha Negra, an alternative rock band. Music and programming share the same essence: the pursuit of expression, the rigor of execution, and building something that connects people.
portfolio_subtitle: We don't just make demo sites. We build solutions that are already working in the market, solving real problems for people and businesses.
portfolio_desc: Consulting and practical support platform for women. The site was designed to convey trust, authority and warmth, with a clear structure of services and booking.
next_project_desc: It could be yours. Let's build something together?
support_subtitle: All HamirStudios software is free and will always be free. If you want to support development, consider a donation or sponsorship.
